refnamediv.refpurpose: Delete a pointer that represents cdt2.

varlistentry.listitem: : is a pointer representing cdt2 to be deleted.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Given a pointer ptr of cdt2, cdt2_delete(ptr,"ptr") frees the memory hold by the pointer ptr and clears ptr in Scialb interpreter. if no parameters are given to cdt2_delete(), then all pointers of differents cdt2 will be deleted.

refsection.title: Examples
